task.problem: A production-shaped TASK-164 PRIMARY wakeup through GitHub Issue #532 failed before self-host dispatch because the hosted carrier imported aios_renew from the pip-installed package and implicitly resolved .ai/executor-profiles.yaml relative to that installed package rather than the canonical repository checkout. Source-tree tests masked the defect because pytest imports through pythonpath=src, where package-relative lookup accidentally coincides with the repository root. Audit confirms the same implicit profile-policy lookup exists in PRIMARY request v3, REMEDIATION intent v2, and coding REPAIR wakeup v2. Executor-less REPAIR remains profile-free and is not itself affected.
